tools.name: list_leagues
tools.title: List leagues
tools.description: All 90+ leagues on football-charts.com with country, league key and the seasons available to your key (newest first). Call this first to resolve league keys and season strings.

tools.name: get_league_table
tools.title: League table
tools.description: Current standings for a league season: position, points, W/D/L, goals, goal difference, last-5 form.

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

season.description: Season string exactly as returned by list_leagues (summer leagues '2026', winter '2026-2027'). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.title: Alternative rankings
tools.description: The table re-ranked by FC's alternative views: 'luck' (luck-adjusted — who over/under-performs their underlying numbers) or 'goals' (highest-scoring matches).

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

season.description: Season string exactly as returned by list_leagues (summer leagues '2026', winter '2026-2027'). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_results
tools.title: Match results
tools.description: Finished matches of a league season with FT/HT scores and first-goal minute, oldest first. Optionally filter by team name substring and cap the number of most recent matches.

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

season.description: Season string exactly as returned by list_leagues (summer leagues '2026', winter '2026-2027'). Omit for the latest.

last.description: Return only the N most recent matches (default: all)

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.title: Upcoming fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming matches of a league with FC's model probabilities (Dixon-Coles based) for HT over 1.5 and FT over 2.5. Probabilities, not betting advice.

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

tools.name: get_match
tools.title: Match detail
tools.description: One match by slug (country/league-slug/date-home-vs-away, as returned by get_fixtures): full model probability block across markets (1X2, over/under lines, BTTS, HT lines), team ratings, first-goal-time histograms.

tools.name: get_season_projection
tools.title: Season projection
tools.description: Monte Carlo season projection (10,000 simulations, refreshed daily): per team the title / top-4 / relegation probability, mean final points and a 10th-90th percentile points range.

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

tools.name: get_team
tools.title: Team page
tools.description: One team in a league season: table row, full match log (scores, HT, venue, outcome), goal-timing bins, first-goal distribution and per-team stats.

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

team.description: Team slug, e.g. 'arsenal' (see get_league_table / list of teams)

season.description: Season string exactly as returned by list_leagues (summer leagues '2026', winter '2026-2027'). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_goal_timing
tools.title: Goal timing heat map
tools.description: When each team in a league scores: goals per 15-minute bin per team, plus league-level stats (most active period, late-goal share).

league.description: League key, e.g. 'premier', 'spain1', 'brazil1', 'wgermany1'. Use list_leagues to discover keys.

season.description: Season string exactly as returned by list_leagues (summer leagues '2026', winter '2026-2027'). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.title: Model track record
tools.description: FC's public, settled prediction track record — every published model signal graded against real results. Transparency data: hit rates and P/L by market, no cherry-picking.
